methodNotes: Scope: conventional jet fuel, international-uplift planning reference in USD/L, prepared 13 November 2026. All 50 final values are estimates. They are not observed November spot prices, negotiated airline invoices, or fully harmonized tax-inclusive prices.

Time alignment: November-effective CPC posting; October Singapore proxy is the equal mean of the two published half-month means; Gulf uses the benchmark disclosed for November tariff setting; Europe uses October cargo mean. These are broadly comparable recent pricing references, not exactly matched daily assessment windows.

Target fuel-cost components: commodity plus reference delivery/commercial components. Tax exemptions, carrier eligibility, contract rebates, credit terms, into-plane inclusions and SAF mandates cannot be fully harmonized from public evidence. Domestic-tax-inclusive schedules are excluded from the central model.

Estimation hierarchy: current airport posting + missing fee; older airport posting + index change; country/facility calibration; regional or peer proxy. Sources and assumptions remain separate and editable.

All bands are analyst-defined sensitivity scenarios, NOT confidence intervals or empirical forecast intervals. They vary location/differential assumptions while holding the chosen commodity anchor fixed. Full market-price/timing risk is additional. Common benchmark changes are correlated across airports.

Airport universe: reconstructed 2025 calendar-year passenger ranking from public airport/regulator figures. Includes geographic Asia: Gulf, Antalya and Asian-side Istanbul SAW; excludes European-side IST and Oceania. Not an official certified ACI top 50. Hanoi traffic remains an explicitly flagged research estimate; rounding and reporting-definition differences can affect near ties.

Repeated prices express missing local differentiation, not evidence that airports actually charge identical prices. Do not use these proxy ties to infer arbitrage or to optimize fuel tankering without better airport data.
Rounded chart values are to 0.01 USD/L for readability, not a claim of cent-level accuracy. Workbook retains calculation precision for reproducibility.
The source table also includes airports outside the selected 50 and older observations. Those rows document research and calibration; they are not additional current price claims.

Recommended academic use: baseline scenario dataset with a source-quality flag and sensitivity analysis. Report results both with and without regional/peer-only airports when testing cross-airport price effects.
